spec.description: OpenAI Codex CLI observability dashboard for OTLP data received by Alloy and stored in Mimir/Loki. Uses Prometheus metrics from Codex and recent logs from Loki.

panels.description: Completed Codex turns, estimated from codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_count.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Turns

panels.description: Total token usage over the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="total"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="total"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Total Tokens

panels.description: cached_input divided by input tokens.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="cached_input"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="cached_input"}[$__range]))) / clamp_min((sum(increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="input"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type="input"}[$__range]))), 1))

panels.title: Cache Hit

panels.description: Tool calls by Codex over the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tool Calls

panels.description: Successful tool calls divided by all tool calls.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(max_over_time(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool", success="true"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(max_over_time(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__range])), 1))

panels.title: Tool Success

panels.description: p95 end-to-end turn latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range]) or max_over_time(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: p95 Turn

panels.description: p95 time to first token.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_ttft_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range]) or max_over_time(codex_turn_ttft_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: p95 First Token

panels.description: p95 time to first model message.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_ttfm_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range]) or max_over_time(codex_turn_ttfm_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: p95 First Message

panels.description: Token usage per interval, split by token_type.

targets.expr: sum by (token_type) (increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", token_type!="total"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Token Usage by Type

panels.description: Total tokens split by model.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", token_type="total"}[$__range])) or sum by (model) (max_over_time(codex_turn_token_usage_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", token_type="total"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Tokens by Model

panels.description: End-to-end turn latency percentiles.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_e2e_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Turn Latency Percentiles

panels.description: TTFT and TTFM p95 latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_ttft_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(codex_turn_ttfm_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: First Token / First Message

panels.description: Tool call rate by tool and success.

targets.expr: sum by (tool, success) (increase(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Tool Calls by Tool

panels.description: p95 tool call duration by tool.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool) (increase(codex_tool_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Tool Latency p95

panels.description: Realtime API websocket events by kind.

targets.expr: sum by (kind) (increase(codex_websocket_event_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: WebSocket Events

panels.description: p95 websocket event duration by event kind.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (increase(codex_websocket_event_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: WebSocket Event p95

panels.description: Codex approval requests over the selected time range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(codex_approval_requested_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or sum(max_over_time(codex_approval_requested_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Approval Requests

panels.description: Approval request outcomes by approved label and tool.

targets.expr: sum by (approved, tool) (max_over_time(codex_approval_requested_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Approval Outcomes

panels.description: Tool calls grouped by sandbox policy.

targets.expr: sum by (sandbox_policy) (max_over_time(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Sandbox Policy

panels.description: Current tool counter value over the selected range, grouped by tool, success, and sandbox policy.

targets.expr: sum by (tool, success, sandbox_policy) (max_over_time(codex_tool_call_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", model=~"$model", tool=~"$tool"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Tool Reliability by Tool

panels.description: Recent Codex OTLP logs from Loki.

targets.expr: {cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job"}

panels.title: Recent Codex Logs

spec.title: Codex
